title: Broad exception catch at line 168 in privileged libvirt helper
detail: A bare `except Exception` at line 168 swallows unexpected errors from a libvirt operation running with elevated privileges. This hides failures that may indicate system inconsistency. Narrow the catch to the specific exception types the operation can raise.

title: open() call without explicit encoding at line 161
detail: A file open at line 161 uses the platform default encoding. In a privsep context running as root, the locale may differ from the calling process. Add `encoding='utf-8'` to make the behaviour explicit.
